compare_title: Without a GPU vs with a GPU: same clips, same software
compare_points: Identical software and models on both sides: the VideoMAE activity model (87M parameters, a look every 0.4 s), the YOLOv8s pose detector, and the vision-language model that writes the detailed subtitles.
Without GPU: this laptop's CPU (Intel(R) Core(TM) Ultra 5 125H) cannot run them in real time, so labels arrive late or not at all and subtitles stay basic.
With GPU (Tesla T4): the same models keep up with the video.
Same clips, 12 seconds each; every figure is what the screen showed.

extra_sides.gpu: NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano Engineering Reference Developer Kit Super
